name: prompt-grapher-vscode
description: Workspace VS Code bridge for PromptGrapher's TypeScript migration shell.

promptGrapher.bridgeCommand.description: Temporary bridge command used to run the legacy Python PromptGrapher CLI during the TypeScript migration.

promptGrapher.pythonBin.description: Optional Python executable used when bridging via a local cli.py entrypoint.

promptGrapher.pythonEntry.description: Optional path to the Python cli.py entrypoint used for local migration work.

promptGrapher.model.description: Optional AI model override. When blank, PromptGrapher falls back to AI_MODEL_NAME or the local .env file.

promptGrapher.baseUrl.description: Optional AI base URL override for OpenAI-compatible providers.

promptGrapher.graphifyStrategy.description: Graph bootstrap mode passed to prompt-grapher analyze.

promptGrapher.graphifyBackend.description: Optional Graphify backend override used only with the semantic bootstrap strategy.

promptGrapher.graphifyArgs.description: Additional arguments forwarded to Graphify. Each item becomes a repeated --graphify-arg flag.

promptGrapher.outputFile.description: Relative output path for the generated Cursor rules file.

promptGrapher.agentsFile.description: Relative output path for the generated AGENTS.md file.

promptGrapher.legacyCursorRulesFile.description: Optional relative output path for a legacy .cursorrules file.

promptGrapher.onboardingDocsDir.description: Optional relative directory for generated onboarding docs.

promptGrapher.memoryPackDir.description: Optional relative directory for generated assistant memory-pack files.

promptGrapher.featurePackDir.description: Optional relative directory for generated feature implementation prompt packs.

promptGrapher.bugPackDir.description: Optional relative directory for generated bug-fix context packs.

promptGrapher.handoffPackDir.description: Optional relative directory for generated client handoff packs. The Generate Client Handoff Pack command defaults to docs/handoff when this is blank.

promptGrapher.featureRequest.description: Optional natural-language request injected into the generated feature prompt pack.

promptGrapher.showMetrics.description: Print the parsed PromptGrapher heuristic summary into the Output panel.
